moveRepositoryWarnDialog.message: If your repository is taking too much space on your main drive, you can move it to some other location. Bear in mind that the new location must always be available in order for IPFS Desktop to work correctly.

repositoryMustBeDirectoryDialog.title: IPFS Repository Must Be a Directory
repositoryMustBeDirectoryDialog.message:
The repository at “{ path }” is invalid, as it is not a directory.

Before starting IPFS Desktop again, please rename the old repository to “.ipfs.backup”. Please note that this will make IPFS Desktop generate a new repository.

repositoryConfigurationIsMissingDialog.title: IPFS Repository Configuration Is Missing
repositoryConfigurationIsMissingDialog.message:
The repository at “{ path }” does not have a “config” file. The “config” file must be a valid JSON file.

Before starting IPFS Desktop again, please fix the configuration file or rename the old repository to “.ipfs.backup”. Please note that by renaming the old repository, IPFS Desktop will generate a new repository.

privateNetworkDialog.title: Private Network IPFS Repository
privateNetworkDialog.message: The repository at “{ path }” is part of a private network, which is not supported by IPFS Desktop.

invalidRepositoryDialog.title: Invalid IPFS Repository or Configuration File
invalidRepositoryDialog.message:
The repository at “{ path }” or its configuration is invalid. The “config” file must be a valid JSON.

Before starting IPFS Desktop again, please fix the configuration file or rename the old repository to “.ipfs.backup”. Please note that by renaming the old repository, IPFS Desktop will generate a new repository

agentConfirm.windowTitle: Confirm a change to your node
agentConfirm.titleWrite: A change to your node is waiting for you
agentConfirm.titleDestructive: A destructive change is waiting for you
agentConfirm.titleNative: Approval happens at the system prompt
agentConfirm.truncated: Shortened here. The full value is longer.
agentConfirm.hintDefault: Closing this window denies the request. Expiry is denial.
agentConfirm.hintNative: Approve it at the system prompt on this computer. Closing this window denies the request.
agentConfirm.hintNoTouchId: This computer cannot ask for Touch ID, so this app can only deny. Approve at the system prompt, or deny here.
agentConfirm.armUnfocused: Click this window to bring it forward. Approve unlocks after it has been in front for {seconds} seconds.
agentConfirm.armChanged: A new request is on screen. Approve unlocks after {seconds} seconds.
agentConfirm.armBlur: This window lost focus. Approve unlocks again after {seconds} seconds in front.
agentConfirm.armReady: Approve is ready. Touch ID is asked next.
agentConfirm.touchBusy: Waiting for Touch ID. Nothing is decided until you confirm.
agentConfirm.errTouchId: Touch ID was not given. Nothing was decided and the request is still pending.
agentConfirm.errUnreachable: The server could not be reached. Nothing was decided. Try again, or deny.
agentConfirm.errNoTouchId: This computer cannot ask for Touch ID, so this app cannot approve.
agentConfirm.resultExpired: Expired. Expiry is denial. Nothing was changed.
agentConfirm.resultGone: No longer pending. Another surface decided it, or the server withdrew it. Nothing was changed here.
agentConfirm.resultRejected: The server does not accept this pairing key. Pair again from the tray menu. Nothing was changed.
agentConfirm.resultUntrusted: That server did not prove it holds the pairing, so this app ignores it. Nothing was changed.
agentConfirm.pairTitle: Pair this app with ipfs mcp
agentConfirm.pairStop: First stop ipfs mcp if it is running. ipfs mcp pair refuses while a server holds a confirmation socket.
agentConfirm.pairRun: Then run ipfs mcp pair in a terminal. It prints a key once and keeps only a hash of it. Enter the key here.
agentConfirm.pairRestart: Then start the server again with --confirm=native,desktop. Desktop is opt-in on the server too: without desktop in that list, nothing reaches this app. Approving here asks for Touch ID.
agentConfirm.pairPrivacy: Without a key this app never contacts the confirmation channel. The key stays in your system keystore and is never sent: every request carries a signature computed from it.
agentConfirm.pairWhyRejected: This window reopened because a running server rejected the stored key. Run ipfs mcp pair again and enter the new key.
agentConfirm.pairShape: That is not a pairing key. It is 43 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, as printed by ipfs mcp pair.
agentConfirm.pairUnavailable: Your system keystore is unavailable, so the key is not stored. Nothing was paired.
agentConfirm.pairFailed: The key could not be stored. Nothing was paired.
agentConfirm.pairDone: Paired. Restart the server with --confirm=native,desktop; a pending write then appears in this app.

dialog.title: Confirm on this computer
dialog.messageBackend: Allow this change to the agent backend?
dialog.detail: This computer has no Touch ID. Your node content may be sent to this host. A stored model key is not sent to a new host; supply a new key if it needs one. Only continue if you started this change yourself.
dialog.detailKeyFollows: This computer has no Touch ID. Your node content may be sent to this host, and so will the model key your server manages, because that key follows a backend change. Only continue if you started this change yourself.

agentSearch.title: Search your node
agentSearch.intro: Search builds an index of the files on this node so you can ask the agent about them. The index is stored in this app's data folder on this computer. It is off until you turn it on.
agentSearch.offHint: Search is off. These settings are saved but not used until you turn it on.
agentSearch.describerHint: A vision model that writes a short description of each image, so images can be found by what they show. Leave both fields empty for none.
agentSearch.save: Save and restart the agent endpoint
agentSearch.saved: Saved. The agent endpoint restarted to apply it.
agentSearch.savedNoRestart: Saved. It applies when the agent endpoint next starts.
agentSearch.bulkPaused: A bulk indexing run was in progress. It is paused; resume it from the agent chat.

status.pending: Search is on and will start with the agent endpoint.

reason.incomplete: Search is on but not set up: choose both programs and fill in the embedder address, model and vector size.
reason.binary_not_absolute: The {{detail}} program needs a full path that starts at the top of the disk.
reason.binary_missing: The {{detail}} program was not found at the path you gave.
reason.binary_not_executable: The {{detail}} program is there but is not allowed to run. Allow it to run (for example chmod +x) and, if macOS blocked it, clear its quarantine flag.
reason.binary_unsafe: The {{detail}} program, or the folder it is in, is not yours (or root's) or can be changed by other users. Move it to a folder only you can write to, or remove the group and other write permission (for example chmod go-w).
reason.embedder_invalid: The embedder address must be https, or http on this computer, with no user name or password.
reason.describer_invalid: The vision model address or name is not valid.
reason.host_not_confirmed: {{detail}} has not been confirmed on this computer, so nothing is sent to it. Save again to be asked.
reason.dir_unsafe: The folder {{detail}} is not private to you (it must be yours and not writable by others).
reason.dir_failed: The folder {{detail}} could not be prepared.

warn.embedderRemote: The text of your files is sent to {{host}}.
warn.videoHosted: Video description is off. It needs a hosted model; this app does not turn it on.

note.resources: Indexing uses your CPU and disk while it runs. It never starts by itself: you start a run from the agent chat, and it stops at the limits set for it.
note.binaries: This app does not download or install anything. Point it at programs you installed yourself. If macOS blocked one after a download, clear its quarantine flag.
note.offline: The document reader runs offline here, so scanned pages and images are not read by text recognition. Plain text, Office files and text PDFs are.
